facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The living room was very messy. Toys lay everywhere on the floor. Ms. Clara picked up a block. She started to sing a song. The children listened and smiled. Soon they sang along. They danced as they cleaned. They cleaned with joy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Toys were scattered all over the living room floor — blocks, books, stuffed animals, and crayons everywhere. Ms. Clara began to hum a soft tune as she lifted the first wooden block. "It is a cleaning song," she whispered with a wink. Emma giggled and joined in with a small voice, and Ben tapped his foot to the rhythm. Soon their tiny hands were sorting toys into baskets, books onto shelves, and crayons into a little tin box. Together, the song carried them through the mess like a gentle breeze. They cleaned with joy, and the room felt brighter with each note. The afternoon sun streamed through the window, and the floor was clean before they knew it.
facts.Word cards: clean = 정리하다 / joy = 즐거움 / sing = 노래하다 / learn = 배우다
